title: Cover
description: AForce — the performance operating system. Performance is non-negotiable. Pause. Hydrate. Lock in. Perform. This is beyond a hydration brand — it is a performance standard.

title: Founder Proof
description: Built where performance is required. No room for inconsistency. No off days. When performance drops, you lose — so it doesn't. Wall Street and entrepreneurship: capital decisions under pressure, building from zero. We built the system we wish we had. AForce exists because of that reality.

title: Mission
description: Performance is non-negotiable. The Brand Truth, the Human Insight, the Category Claim. The daily ritual: Morning, Midday, Pre-performance, Recovery. Voiced by strategic advisors Kristel van Kleef and Peter Ingwersen.

title: Problem
description: The Disruption. The energy category is loud by design (Red Bull, Monster, Celsius) — every other brand shows up after performance breaks down. AForce shows up before. The new territory: focus, control, consistency.

title: Insight
description: The edge is not louder — it is quieter. The Performance Moment: Kobe before the court, Beyoncé before the stage. Old model (React. Push. Hope.) vs. the AForce ritual (Pause. Hydrate. Lock in. Perform.). AForce ensures nothing gets in the way.

title: Timing
description: National attention at the moment of launch. Spring 2026 launch → Summer 2026 filming → Fall 2026 national broadcast. Visibility meets availability. Demand meets supply.

title: Product
description: One system. Three flavors. Two formats. One outcome — sustained performance. Stability, recovery, output under pressure. This is not hydration. This is performance fuel.

title: Formats
description: Same system. Two formats. Cans for the cooler, sticks for the road — both feed the same performance loop.

title: AForce OS
description: The intelligence layer. Product fuels the body. AForce OS tells you what to do next. Three steps: Score (reads your state), Command (tells you what to do), Improve (learns over time). No wearable required. Starts simple. Gets smarter over time.

title: The Loop
description: Performance loop. Drink → Score → Coach → Decide. Same system. Every state of the body.

title: Product Tour
description: One system. Multiple states. Performance Score, Social Mode, Recovery Mode — the OS adapts to every state of the body.

title: Sweat Calculator
description: Inside the OS — six inputs become a peer-reviewed sweat profile and an exact AForce protocol. Measure → engine → replenish, with every number traceable to ACSM 2007, Baker 2017, Maughan-Shirreffs 2010, and Périard 2015.

title: OS Roadmap
description: Building the performance layer. AI Coach (2026, consumer) → Clutch (2027, team SaaS) → Guardian (2028, enterprise + medical). $216B+ TAM, $48B SAM, $1.4B SOM.

title: At Scale
description: Performance at scale. Clutch puts the coach in command of game-day roster tiers; Guardian gives medical and enterprise teams composite risk + critical alerts on the same loop. Individual to team to system.

title: Community
description: Performance becomes visible. The AForce League — 12 cities, 84K members competing weekly on Performance Score. Every can logs to your zip; the community turns customers into a flywheel.

title: Market
description: The performance economy. AForce sits at the intersection of product, behavior, and data — functional beverages, sports drinks, and stick mixes all converging.

title: Competitive Advantage
description: System is the moat. CPG is copied. Systems compound. Others sell products. AForce builds performance infrastructure.

title: Competitors
description: No competitor operates a system. AForce vs. Liquid IV, LMNT, BodyArmor, Gatorade, Prime — the category has drinks. AForce has a loop.

title: Go-To-Market
description: Build. Scale. Lead. Six phases from DTC launch to global category leader. We don't sell hydration — we install a daily performance system. Hardware scales. Software compounds. The OS creates retention.

title: Traction
description: Momentum before launch. $832K closed, 179 launch creators, 2.3M+ watching before product is on shelf, America's Real Deal Season 2 national TV premiere. Product ready. System ready. Demand building.

title: Path to $3.2M
description: Growth driven by repeat behavior. 60,000 orders × $52 AOV = $3.2M. Five-stage acquisition→retention engine. Performance creates retention. Retention drives revenue.

title: Financial Projections
description: Scaling a performance system. $3.2M (2026) → $13M (2027) → $27.8M (2028). EBITDA breakeven late 2027. The product creates entry. The system creates compounding value.

title: Unit Economics
description: Bottoms-up model: 40/25/20/15 product mix, $52×5–7×/65%=$383 CLTV ÷ $49 CAC = 5:1 LTV:CAC. Benchmarked vs Liquid I.V./LMNT. SaaS layer modeled as upside.

title: Recurring Engine
description: Every user becomes a system. Three layers: Product (entry), Subscription / OS (recurring intelligence), Data Loop (compounding asset). Performance creates habit. Habit creates subscription. Subscription creates enterprise value.

title: Funding & Use of Funds
description: $4M Series Seed Preferred. Q1 2026 close. 40/20/20/10/10 allocation across inventory, GTM, OS, distribution, team.

title: Team
description: Brandon Burrell, Julius Burrell — with advisors Mark Mendel, Adam Sobol, Thomas Masterbouni, and Chief Scientist Mark Satterfield.

title: The Ask
description: Performance is non-negotiable. AForce makes sure you're always on. Where there are no off days. No missed moments. Two brothers, built under pressure. We're raising $4M to define the performance category — scale manufacturing + inventory, launch AForce OS + subscription layer, expand retail + DTC channels, build brand + cultural presence. The edge is not louder. It is quieter.
